description: A four-team synthetic league whose pre-game ratings a human works out by hand. Six games chosen to exercise every rule in the system exactly once: a plain home game, an FBS team losing to a fixed-1200 FCS opponent, a close game, a neutral-site upset with no home-field advantage, a season boundary with pre-season regression, and a second-season game between two regressed teams.
instructions: Work out, by hand, the rating each team carries OUT of each game - the post-game ratings - plus the end-of-2014 ratings before regression and the final ratings. Use a calculator and the method below, not this project's code: a fixture whose answers came from the code it checks proves nothing. Then set human_verified/verified_by/verified_on. tests/test_gold_elo.py compares your numbers against the engine to 6 decimal places, and separately chains them forward - applying the season regression itself - to check every pre-game rating the pipeline stores.

method.expected: E_home = 1 / (1 + 10 ^ (-(R_home - R_away + HFA) / 400)), HFA = 0 at a neutral site
method.mov_multiplier: ln(|margin| + 1) * 2.2 / (0.001 * winner_elo_diff + 2.2), where winner_elo_diff is the WINNER's pre-game rating minus the loser's with HFA included, and is negative when the underdog won
method.update: delta = K * mov_multiplier * (S_home - E_home); home_post = R_home + delta, away_post = R_away - delta; S_home is 1 for a home win, 0 for a home loss, 0.5 for a tie
method.fcs: An FCS team is rated a fixed 1200 in every game and never updates. Its FBS opponent updates normally, so delta is applied to the FBS side only.
method.season_regression: At the start of each new season, every tracked FBS rating becomes R + (1500 - R) * regression
method.initialisation: Every team that is FBS in the first season starts at 1500. Nobody in this league enters FBS later.

games.case: opening game, both teams at the initial rating
FBS team hosts a fixed-1200 FCS opponent and loses
one-point game between two teams that have already played
neutral site, so no home-field advantage, and the road team wins big
first game of the second season, so both ratings have been regressed
second season, one team already updated this year and one not

season_end_2014.note: Ratings after the last 2014 game and BEFORE the pre-season regression. Delta is absent because an FCS team is never tracked. The test applies the regression to these to derive what game 5 must have started from.

final_ratings.note: Ratings after game 6, which is the only way the last game's update gets checked.
